findings.issue: Decision ID D-RCV-60 appears in the scenario titles of AC8 and AC9. Decision IDs must not appear in the story.
The second 'AC8' scenario duplicates the AC ID of the first. Its content is covered by TC-S9-E7015-CON-09, so it is removed.
TC-S9-E7015-CON-08 is listed twice. The AC8-tagged row duplicates TC-09 content; the AC7 row is the one that matches R-21559 and is kept.
AC9 and TC-10 assert write-once, one-transaction and restart behaviour that no source gives. These must be marked Not specified in the source documents.
The legacy paragraph says eight new cases, -01 to -08. With TC-09 and TC-10 added there are ten, -01 to -10.
